description: This is a PHP unit test class for testing the functionality of EmailQueueDao in the OrangeHRM core plugin, including methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting email queue entries.

classes.name: EmailQueueDaoTest
classes.description: Unit testing class for EmailQueueDao, ensuring email queue operations such as get, save, delete, and retrieve pending emails function correctly.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, creating an instance of EmailQueueDao, setting the fixture path, populating test data, and creating the test kernel.

methods.name: testGetEmail
methods.description: Tests retrieving an email by ID from the email queue, asserting subject and body correctness.

methods.name: testSaveEmail
methods.description: Tests saving a new email entity into the queue, setting various properties and verifying persistence and correctness.

methods.name: testRemoveFromQueue
methods.description: Tests removing emails from the queue by their IDs and asserts correct number of deletions.

methods.name: testGetAllPendingMailIds
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of all pending email IDs in the queue and their order.
